positive_prompts: Create a new Python library called acme-utils with pytest, ruff and CI ready to go.
Convert my setup.py and requirements.txt project to a modern pyproject.toml with uv.
Add a Makefile and pre-commit hooks for linting and testing to my Python package.

negative_prompts.prompt: Write property-based tests with Hypothesis for my parser module.
Build a wheel and publish my library to PyPI with trusted publishing.
Bump the version to 2.0.0 and update the changelog for the release.

rubric: Runs skills/python/project-setup/scripts/create_project.py (or equivalent steps) from a scratch parent directory, producing a src-layout package directory
pyproject.toml exists with [project] metadata, a build backend, and a src/<package>/py.typed marker
A tests/ directory exists and the generated test passes when pytest is run
Ruff lint and format checks pass on the generated project
.github/workflows contains a CI workflow that runs lint and tests
The helper is not run inside the skills repository checkout, leaving no stray generated directory
